name.en: GT2 80-tooth pulley, 6 mm belt, 5 mm bore
name.es: Polea GT2 de 80 dientes, banda de 6 mm, barreno de 5 mm
name.fr: Poulie GT2 à 80 dents, courroie de 6 mm, alésage de 5 mm
name.pt: Polia GT2 de 80 dentes, correia de 6 mm, furo de 5 mm

description.en: A flanged GT2 (2GT) timing pulley with 80 teeth for a 6 mm belt and a 5 mm set-screw bore. A commercial class: the tooth count, pitch, pitch diameter and bore are shared; the hub and flange dimensions are one listing's ('Small' variant). In a Voron 2.4-class Z drive it is the driven pulley of the 5:1 reduction, on the 5 mm output shaft.
description.es: Una polea síncrona GT2 (2GT) con pestañas, de 80 dientes para banda de 6 mm y barreno de 5 mm con prisioneros. Una clase comercial: el número de dientes, el paso, el diámetro primitivo y el barreno son comunes; las medidas del cubo y las pestañas son de un listado (variante «Small»). En un accionamiento Z de clase Voron 2.4 es la polea conducida de la reducción 5:1, en la flecha de salida de 5 mm.
description.fr: Une poulie crantée GT2 (2GT) à flasques, à 80 dents pour courroie de 6 mm et alésage de 5 mm à vis de pression. Une classe commerciale : le nombre de dents, le pas, le diamètre primitif et l'alésage sont communs ; les cotes du moyeu et des flasques sont celles d'une fiche (variante « Small »). Dans un entraînement Z de classe Voron 2.4, c'est la poulie menée de la réduction 5:1, sur l'arbre de sortie de 5 mm.
description.pt: Uma polia sincronizada GT2 (2GT) com flanges, de 80 dentes para correia de 6 mm e furo de 5 mm com parafusos de fixação. Uma classe comercial: o número de dentes, o passo, o diâmetro primitivo e o furo são comuns; as medidas do cubo e das flanges são de uma listagem (variante «Small»). Num acionamento Z de classe Voron 2.4 é a polia movida da redução 5:1, no eixo de saída de 5 mm.

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of end face A, the hub end, on the bore axis. +z runs along the bore through the hub (8 mm) and then the flanged toothed section to end face B, the flange end, at z = 18 (the cited 'Small' variant). The belt's mid-plane is taken at the middle of the 10 mm beyond the hub, z = 13. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the pulley is round, so both interfaces have continuous symmetry.

flange_diameter.note: 'Small' variant; the listing's other variants give 54.1 and 55

toothed_width.note: the listing gives 7 to 7.2 by variant

belt_width.note: the Voron 2.4 motion set's 80T is the 6 mm-wide pulley

label.en: Bore at the hub end (face A)
label.es: Barreno en el extremo del cubo (cara A)
label.pt: Furo no lado do cubo (face A)

interfaces.note: Female: the bore takes the shaft hub end first. Framed at face A (the hub end), normal −z out of that face, so a shaft framed where face A lands, its normal toward the pulley, puts the pulley beyond it. The bore carries the Z drive's shaft-hub key (z-drive-pulley-hub-5mm): a set-screw hub on a Ø5 D-cut shaft.

label.en: Bore at the flange end (face B)
label.es: Barreno en el extremo de la pestaña (cara B)
label.pt: Furo no lado da flange (face B)

interfaces.note: Female: the same bore entered flange end first (the pulley turned round). Framed at face B, z = 18, normal +z out of that face.

pitch_diameter.note: Gates 2MR-80S gives 2.005 in (sources 1 and 2) = 50.93 mm (×25.4, rounded to 0.01); 80 × 2 / π = 50.93

belt_engagement.plane_note: Derived from one listing's cited heights, not one cited number: the 8 mm hub, then the flanged toothed section to the 18 mm overall height with the belt centred in it, so the mid-plane is at 8 + (18 − 8)/2 = 13 from face A. The axis is the bore axis.

solids.note: the flanged toothed section at the flange diameter

envelope.note: Hub, then the flanged toothed section at the 'Small' variant's flange diameter; the bore is not hollowed, so the shaft overlaps it.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-ZBED lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The pitch diameter is a Gates sprocket's: the 2 mm GT2 pitch circle of 80 grooves is the same for every maker.
